common_source: Universal on the two copy slots and with frozen three-family Yukawa Y. A single aligned source and a gauge conversion identifying its two normalized light lines are required for the Gram bound.
witness: Three heavy 5 with three extra 5bar and canonical kinetic terms. In units of a common positive parent mass the color and weak rows are (-q a,a) and (I,q a) with I=x s^4. Take a equal to the existing real coefficient i0 of the optional 1685 stabilizing polynomial I^2+i0 I+i0^2. Its reuse in this mass vertex is an additional linkage. The normalized common Yukawa source sees the first copy only. SU(5)-violating Dirac masses can be realized using the declared singlet plus adjoint projectors.
